projectDescription: A logistics tracking system built for Scanmex that replaces paper-based delivery routes with a real-time GPS web dashboard and a Zebra terminal Android app integrated with SAP Business One.
keyFeatures: Real-time GPS fleet tracking via web dashboard
Android app for Zebra rugged terminals with barcode scanning
ASP.NET Core 8 MVC web dashboard built in C#
SAP Business One Service Layer (OData v4) integration
SQL Server backend shared by both applications
Automatic delivery confirmation synced to SAP without double entry
Interactive MVC architecture explainer with restaurant analogy
Filterable technical glossary covering 10+ key terms
Curated AI tools catalogue organized by development phase
publicApiSurface: Web Dashboard (C# / ASP.NET Core 8 MVC) — route assignment and live map
Android App (Java/Kotlin) — delivery list, GPS broadcast, barcode scan confirmation
SAP Business One Service Layer REST/OData v4 — order synchronization
SQL Server database — shared persistence layer (connection string constant: sqlconsap)
Google Maps API — driver position visualization
Geolocation API — periodic GPS position reporting from the mobile app
